name: 葉采青
objective: 本課程旨在引導學生閱讀英美短篇故事，探討其敘事技巧、情節、人物、觀點和語言等，如何在故事中建構意義，並著重故事所傳達的文化意涵。
schedule:
Week 1		Orientation; Guy de Maupassant, “The Diamond Necklace” (1884)
Week 2		Guy de Maupassant, “The False Gems” (1883)
Week 3		William Dean Howells, “Editha” (1905)
Week 4		Raymond Carver, “What We Talk About When We Talk About Love” (1981)
Week 5		Kate Chopin, “The Storm” (1898)
Week 6		Margaret Atwood, “Happy Endings” (1983); Group practice
Week 7		Richard Wright, “The Man Who Was Almost a Man” (1961)
Week 8		Jack London, “To Build a Fire” (1908)
Week 9		Mid-term exam
Week 10-11	F. Scott Fitzgerald, “Winter Dreams” (1922)
Week 12-13	Herman Melville, “Bartleby, the Scrivener” (1853)
Week 14-15	Franz Kafka, “The Metamorphosis” (1915)
Week 16-17	Postmodernism and Donald Barthelme, “The School” (1974)
Week 18		Final exam
scorePolicy:
Attendance and participation: 15%
Assignment: 20%
Midterm exam: 30%
Final exam: 35%
課程對應SDGs指標: SDG4：優質教育（Quality Education）SDG5：性別平等（Gender Equality）SDG10：減少不平等（Reduced Inequalities）SDG13：氣候行動（Climate Action）SDG16：和平正義與有力的制度（Peace, Justice and Strong Institutions）
課程是否導入AI: ● 使用生成式 AI 作為教學過程的輔助工具（Use generative AI tools as an aid to the teaching process）● 使用生成式 AI 進行課堂即時互動（Use generative AI for real-time classroom interaction）
